Tensor Analysis – Practical 11 Information: • These exercises are design to revise the whole module. • The exercises are not organised by difficulty. 11.1 Write the vector equation u + (a · b)v = |a| 2(b · v)a in suffix notation. 11.2 Let f be a scalar field. Using suffix notation, evaluate the following expression ∇ × (∇f ). 11.3 Write the transformation law for the following tensors. (1) A rank 5 tensor in Cartesian coordinates. (2) A rank 5 contravariant tensor in generalised coordinates. (3) The rank 5 mixed tensor T kℓ · · p · ·mn · in generalised coordinated. 11.4 Given a Cartesian coordinate system K with orthonormal basis i1, i2, i3, consider the coordinate system K′ with basis vectors e1 = i1 + i3, e2 = i2 − i3, e3 = i1 − i2 + i3. (1) Compute the dual basis vectors e1, e2, e3. (2) Compute the covariant components of the vector V = i1 − 2i3 with respect to the bases e1, e2, e3 and e1, e2, e3 of part (a). (3) Compute the contravariant components of the vector V = i1 − 2i3 with respect to the bases e1, e2, e3 and e1, e2, e3 of part (a). (4) Find the components of the rotation matrix L = (L j i′). (5) Express the covariant components of the second-order tensor of K with components [Pik] = [P ik] = [P ·k i ] = [P i ·k] =   0 1 0 −1 0 −1 0 0 1   in the coordinate system K′. 1

2 11.5 In this question, consider the two-dimensional orthogonal coordinate system (x1, x2) = (x, θ) with position r given by r = ex sin θi1 + ex cos θi2, where i1, i2 are the usual 2 dimensional Cartesian basis vectors. (1) Compute the basis vectors e1, e2, e3 of this coordinate system. (2) Compute the metric tensor gik of this coordinate system. (3) Describe the arc length element in terms of the metric coefficients. (4) Determine the Christoffel symbols of the first kind for the given coordinate system. (5) Determine the Christoffel symbols of the second kind for the given coordinate system. (6) Compute the following components of the Riemann-Christoffel tensor R1 111, R2 121, R1 222.
